benchmark_method: Five sequential runs per binary per workload, alternating order; normal clocks; posix_spawn and per-child wait4; warm filesystem caches, no explicit warmup; raw outputs compared on every pair.
phase: Combined four optimization passes; diverse conversion, window and PCA memory paths
baseline_commit_scope: Regression compares original commit in each matching build configuration; performance compares previous delivered third-pass source with final fourth-pass source.

normal.clock: fixed_time.c linked in both executables; no output normalization

lapack.clock: fixed_time.c linked in both executables; no output normalization

Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.6.0

InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin
row_helper_probe.contract: Raw output bytes, remaining input bytes, consumed bytes, input state and flush counts; default stream exception mask.
limitations: Stream-contract probe only; CLI regression and performance are separate.
Read failures are injected through streambuf::underflow; arbitrary OS failure timing is not modeled.

cxx98_syntax_check.existing_warnings: Variable-length arrays already present in unchanged source; see verification/memory/cxx98.log.

limitations: Finite corpus and synthetic benchmarks on macOS arm64 with Apple Clang21; not a proof of byte equivalence for every possible input/platform or a production-wide speed claim.
Normal and LAPACK-enabled regressions are separate configurations compared against corresponding original builds. Performance compares previous delivered third pass, not original commit.
Fixed clocks control diagnostics and RNG seeds without output normalization. Normal-clock benchmarks compare result bytes and report elapsed-time diagnostic differences separately.
PCA uses the same Accelerate framework with VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 for both versions. No equivalence claim across numerical-library versions or compilers.

Existing PCA missing-genotype handling can produce ragged M rows and out-of-bounds reads for unfiltered negative genotype sums. These undefined paths are not repaired or covered by the byte-equivalence claim; explicit missing-site filtering is tested.

Private temporary filenames are random and excluded from the public output-file comparison. Post-check verified identical retained scratch-byte multisets in the same 12 error cases, without changing original cleanup behavior.

Five converter workloads trade large RAM reductions for small timing changes in either direction. Long-allele012 did not lower measured peak RSS, and chromosome-revisit pi retained roughly the same peak memory.
No universal RAM nonincrease guarantee: parsing, vector capacity, allocator behavior, libraries and page rounding also affect peak RSS. All measured differences are retained.
Perl, relatedness, LROH and the eigensolver are unchanged in this pass.
